case.display_name: In re FTX Trading Ltd. — Fifth Distribution (July 31, 2026)
case.case_name: FTX Trading Ltd. d/b/a FTX.com and FTX Recovery Trust

coverage.headline: FTX begins fifth creditor payout of $900M, total repayments reach $10B
coverage.summary: The FTX Recovery Trust initiated its fifth creditor distribution of $900 million on July 31, with verified claimants receiving funds via wire transfers or designated exchanges, bringing cumulative repayments to approximately $10 billion since FTX's Chapter 11 filing in November 2022.

coverage.headline: FTX to distribute roughly $900 million to creditors in fifth wave of payouts
coverage.summary: FTX announced it will begin distributing approximately $900 million to creditors on July 31, 2026 — its fifth distribution under its Chapter 11 plan — bringing cumulative repayments to nearly $10 billion since payouts began in 2025. Eligible Convenience and Non-Convenience class claimants who met the June 16 record date will receive funds within three business days via BitGo, Kraken, or Payoneer.

coverage.headline: FTX to Distribute $900M to Creditors in Fifth Payment Round
coverage.summary: The FTX Recovery Trust announced its fifth creditor distribution of ~$900 million starting July 31, covering convenience and non-convenience classes with recoveries ranging from 103% to 120% of allowed claim values based on November 2022 petition-date prices. The round follows a $2.2 billion March 2026 distribution, bringing total estate payouts to approximately $10 billion.

coverage.headline: FTX to Pay Creditors Another $900M in Fifth Bankruptcy Distribution
coverage.summary: FTX's fifth distribution of ~$900 million will lift cumulative recoveries to 105% for Dotcom and U.S. customer entitlement claims, and to 103% for general unsecured and digital asset loan claims, calculated against 2022 petition-date valuations. A separate $18 million second payment will also be made to preferred equity holders from the Preferred Shareholder Remission Fund Trust on July 31.

coverage.headline: FTX Plans to Pay Creditors $900 Million as Fifth Distribution Starts on July 31
coverage.summary: FTX Trading Ltd. and the FTX Recovery Trust will distribute ~$900 million beginning July 31, with Class 7 Convenience Claims reaching a cumulative 120% recovery and other classes hitting 103–105%. The estate has not announced a date for a sixth distribution, and disputed-claims resolution and final wind-down work continue.
